mapper.select: SELECT enrollments.id, courses.code AS course_code, courses.name AS course_name, users.name AS professor_name, lectures.room, lectures.schedule, courses.credits, enrollments.status FROM enrollments JOIN lectures ON enrollments.lecture_id = lectures.id JOIN courses ON lectures.course_id = courses.id JOIN users ON lectures.professor_id = users.id WHERE enrollments.student_id = #{studentId} AND lectures.year = #{year} AND lectures.semester = #{semester}
